The '''Nihil Retreat''' was a collection of twelve [[Star cluster/Legends|stellar clusters]] located in [[Unknown Regions]] and associated with the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]]. The star clusters were ruled by the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization that espoused the [[Way of the Dark]].<ref name="LSatSoM" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' first established the Nihil Retreat as "twelve stellar clusters within" the Perann Nebula,<ref name="LSatSoM" /> however, ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' establishes the Nihil Retreat and it's twelve stellar clusters as forming "a protective bulwark around the Perann Nebula," as well stating the Retreat contains only twelve planets.<ref name="TUR" /> The [[2015]] update to the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' simply stated the Perann Nebula to be located within the Unknown Regions. [[Lucasfilm]] has yet to provide clarification for this discrepancy.
